object_description: squat sunken base with an elevated ground-floor volume
design_condition: The lowered base creates complex terrain changes and a ditch-like front zone, divides the site into levels, and disrupts the characteristic front garden while orienting the building toward its neighbors.

positive.statement: The simple linear bulkhead structure and logical repetitive structure are clear.
The two uses are clearly separated spatially.
Protected entrances for all basic levels and an independent entrance provide direct access to the outdoor space.
The basic-level floor plans are identical and well thought out.
The day-school floor plan allows flexible use through open or separable units.
The simple repetitive structure enables economical construction and maintenance.
The project is compatible with the stated sustainability standards.

negative.statement: The terrain intervention severely disrupts the characteristic front garden and creates a ditch-like front zone.
The front outdoor space is significantly too small for the basic levels.
The lowered direct location is unsatisfactory and problematic for basic-level use.
The rooms dug into the rear receive too little daylight.
The proposal is not permitted under building law and exceeds the permitted dimensions and limit distances.
The internal connection between the levels is provided only by the lift, while a staircase is possible only through the exterior.
The visual connection to the northern outdoor space from the basement is insufficient.
The permeability between classes is possible only via the forecourt; an internal connection would be desirable.
Despite the courtyards, natural light will remain too scarce in the deep rooms and group rooms.
The garden entrance through the lawn is impractical.
The outdoor design is limited and leaves otherwise unfurnished areas, while bicycle parking remains unclear.
The extensive subterranean concrete structures create a high proportion of gray energy.
System separation is possible only to a limited extent because of the floor channel.
